verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents Payment Links as "the easiest way for you to accept payments online without a digital storefront," and its invoicing docs say you can generate digital payment links supporting 160+ local payment methods. Together these cover the core of the story: a shareable link that accepts payments without building a site. missing for 10: explicit documentation that links are created from the dashboard with no code, evidence on how quickly a new account can start selling (onboarding/activation time), independent or hands-on corroboration.
